operations.name: evaluate_frame
operations.signature: fn evaluate_frame<'a>(view: SceneView<'a>, time_seconds: f64, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<EvaluatedFrame<'a>>; fn update_animation_clips(frame: &mut EvaluatedFrame<'_>, shape: ShapeId, update_bounds: bool, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<()>
operations.implementation: evaluate_frame applies supported active overlay items in order and returns an owned EvaluatedFrame; clip updates are blocked by missing mutable shared frame API; raster dispatch is blocked by absent concrete kernel/provider adapters.
operations.contract: G1 evaluate_view, no parsed track/source clone/reparse; existing overlay order and active flags; instance-specific ancestor transform chains, geometry/paint-bbox/stroke inverse update, deduplicated clip clone with owner-before-suffix. Preserve current unsupported animated effect/pattern/path behavior, classify errors, never silently render static substitute.
